Inherited disorder of central sleep-wake regulation; an immune mechanism is not established across hereditary forms.

Congenital postaxial extra digits are a skeletal malformation.
Enteropathy, hair abnormalities and immunodeficiency define the syndrome; hepatic fibrosis/cirrhosis occurs in 30-79%. Neurodevelopmental impairment (30-79%) omitted by cap.
Senior-Loken syndrome is defined by nephronophthisis and retinal dystrophy; retinal disease occurs in 5/6 and advanced kidney disease in 6/8 reported patients.
NKX2-1-related chorea; intrinsic thyroid dysfunction affects roughly 50-70% and developmental/surfactant-related lung disease roughly 40-60%; expression varies.
A ventricular tachyarrhythmia arising from abnormal cardiac repolarization.
Inherited focal epilepsy with sleep-related hypermotor seizures.
Partial 19q duplication commonly causes developmental delay and intellectual disability; other organ malformations vary with the duplicated segment and lack frequency evidence here.
A neurologic movement disorder causing episodic dystonia and choreoathetosis; muscle movements do not establish primary muscle damage.
Vaginal secretion is confined to the reproductive tract; infection is one possible cause, not intrinsic to this concept.
Inherited retinal disease caused by recessive PROM1 variants.
Mixed teratoma-seminoma is typically a testicular germ cell tumor; reproductive organs have no axis, and no extragonadal organ of origin is specified.
Vaginal discharge is a reproductive-tract manifestation; no infectious cause is established by this concept.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; the USH1C association does not establish retinal disease in this concept.
Local hydroxyapatite deposition causes periarticular inflammation; no systemic metabolic or immune disorder is established.
